summary: Lead your squadron in an epic WW2 shoot 'em up! Dodge bullets & battle bosses!
description: The ultimate WW2 shoot 'em up experience has reached your mobile device! Master the skies and outmaneuver relentless enemy forces to survive a deadly bullet storm. ACES OF THE LUFTWAFFE - SQUADRON is an action-packed vertical scrolling shoot ‘em up with a fascinating and fully voiced narrative. Master evasive maneuvers to survive the intense bullet hell, collect massive power-ups, and unleash special abilities to obliterate your enemies. Experience two campaigns with 50 levels in total, waves of deadly aerial war machines, and epic boss fights. Are you up to the aerial combat task? 🌍 A World at War: Two Epic Campaigns When Europe seemed to be free, a secret German commando called The Aces of the Luftwaffe took their chance to strike back and invade the USA! It’s your duty to restore peace and liberty aboard deadly wings of steel in bombastic aerial shoot 'em up battles! 🛩️ Choose Your Side However, every story has two sides. As the Aces of the Luftwaffe begin their assault on the United States, you are charged with leading a squad of elite German pilots on a secret mission. Embark on an epic aerial adventure of intrigue and deceit from a secret base in the Bermuda Triangle. Choose your side, decide your role, and take off into the ultimate WW2 shoot 'em up! Key Features: 💥 Action-packed WW2 shoot ’em up with explosive special effects 🛡️ Command heroic NPC wingmen to multiply your firepower and cover your flanks ⚙️ Upgrade your squadron via deep skill trees, unlocking devastating individual abilities 🏅 Prove your aerial superiority through a challenging achievement system 🗣️ Immerse yourself in a captivating storyline with fully voiced characters 🗺️ Master 50 action-packed levels, turning evasive maneuvers into deadly strikes 👹 Survive 12 spectacular, screen-filling boss fights 🎶 Experience the action to an epic, movie-like orchestral soundtrack © THQ Nordic Mobile 2026
